title: Enable internal SLS hooks for harms evaluations
summary: Internal hooks are added to the Sales Lines Suggestions feature to support harms evaluations. An internal event fires after chat completions and a CSV query-building method becomes internal for test reuse.
key_points: New internal event OnAfterGenerateChatCompletion fires after text and attachment completion calls
CSV BuildSearchQuery method changed from local to internal for test reuse
Harms test app added to internalsVisibleTo list for dedicated test visibility
Internal visibility enforced at compiler level, restricting subscription to module and friend apps
No business flow or prompt changes; purely test infrastructure support
